name: Resize PDF Pages to A4 or Letter

seo.title: Resize PDF Pages to A4 or Letter — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Place each source PDF page onto new A4 or Letter pages with contain, cover or stretch fit and configurable margins.

assumptions: Source pages are embedded into new target pages; vector content remains vector where supported by the library.
limitations: Page resizing can alter print scale and invalidate signatures; annotations/forms may not transfer with all semantics.
